display.title: T3: The Metallurgic Infuser
display.subtitle: The alloy workbench
description: The §bMetallurgic Infuser§r is where Mekanism's material tree begins -
infuse iron with redstone, diamond, or carbon to produce the §bAlloys§r that
every advanced machine and circuit demands.
Build a Metallurgic Infuser to complete this beat. It is the cheapest
Mekanism machine and the prerequisite for everything richer.
